statusLine.command: input=$(cat); session=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.session_id'); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); dir=$(basename "$cwd"); git_info=""; if git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo "detached"); if ! git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks diff --quiet 2>/dev/null || ! git -C "$cwd" --no-optional-locks diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null; then git_info=$(printf " \\e[33m[%s*]\\e[0m" "$branch"); else git_info=$(printf " \\e[32m[%s]\\e[0m" "$branch"); fi; fi; printf "\e[1m%s\e[0m │ \e[36m%s\e[0m%s" "$session" "$dir" "$git_info"
